Each user has their own projects now. Starting a task only pauses your own other tasks, so several people can work at the same time.

## Download

- **macOS 13 or newer** (Apple Silicon and Intel): [TasksBar.zip](https://github.com/Astervista/tasks/releases/download/v3.0.0/TasksBar.zip)
- **Windows** (64-bit): [TasksTray.exe](https://github.com/Astervista/tasks/releases/download/v3.0.0/TasksTray.exe)

The apps aren't signed yet, so your system will warn you the first time:

- **macOS:** unzip, move `TasksBar.app` to Applications (replacing the old one), then run this once:
  ```sh
  xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/TasksBar.app
  ```
- **Windows:** choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

## What's new

- **Projects per user:** the web app, the CLI and the tray apps only show your own projects. Someone else's project doesn't exist for you, even with its uid.
- **One running task per person:** starting a task pauses your other running task, not other people's.
- **The server checks who you are itself:** on every request it asks the login service, over the internal network, who the session belongs to and whether it has the `tasks` permission. It trusts nothing the request says about its user.
- **Registering a folder again keeps its history:** `tasks init` in a folder the server doesn't have for your account offers to make a new project from the folder's files, keeping todos, ids, time and the archive.

## Upgrading

The projects from before belong to nobody: they stay on the server, untouched, and nobody sees them. Everyone registers their folders again. Do it in this order:

1. **Login service:** update it to the version that answers `X-Permission`, before the tasks server. An older one makes the tasks server refuse every request.
2. **Server:** deploy as described in [DEPLOY.md](https://github.com/Astervista/tasks/blob/v3.0.0/DEPLOY.md). `.env` needs nothing new: the login service's address, `http://astervista-auth-backend:1000/permission`, is the default.
3. **Command line tool:** update it from a copy of this repository:
   ```sh
   git pull && npm ci && npm run cli:install
   ```
   Then run `tasks init` in each project folder. `tasks status` lists the folders still to do.
4. **Projects that only lived on the server:** they're in `data/workspaces/<uid>/`. To keep one, copy its `TODO.md` and `TODO.archive.md` into an empty folder and run `tasks init` there.

The tray apps need no update, but this release has them too. See "Moving to separate users (3.0)" in DEPLOY.md for the details.
